part.text: The doc-test and lib-test failures are pre-existing on the pristine tree (environment feature config, unrelated to the change). Final diff:

Fixed. The root cause: when the last `Sender` drops, `send2(None)` sets `tail.closed` and increments `tail.pos` past a closed sentinel slot that isn't stored as a normal value. `new_receiver` (used by both `resubscribe` and `subscribe`) set `next = tail.pos`, pointing *past* the sentinel — so `recv` waited forever on a value that will never arrive and `try_recv` returned `Empty`.

The fix in tokio/src/sync/broadcast.rs:633 starts the new receiver one position earlier when the channel is closed, so it observes the closed marker and correctly returns `RecvError::Closed`/`TryRecvError::Closed`.

Verified:
- All 25 tests in `sync_broadcast.rs` pass, including the previously failing `resubscribe_to_closed_channel`
- The issue's reproduction program now prints `Closed`/`Done` instead of hanging, and `try_recv` returns `Closed`
- Remaining doc-test/lib-test failures were confirmed pre-existing on the pristine tree (unrelated feature-config issues)
